description: Internal alterations and refurbishment. External enhancements forming a seating area, with raised planting beds, pergola and festoon lighting. New lantern to front elevation.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01, 100 Rev. D, 102, 105, 200, 201, 202, 203, 204, Design Heritage and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, Lighting Assessment, Resin Bond - Resin Aggregate Surfacing. Received: 11/07/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The external seating areas hereby permitted shall not be open to customers between 22:00 - 08:00.

Condition : 4 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, and notwithstanding what is shown on the approved drawings, a visibility splay of 2.4 metres x 2.4 metres shall be provided on each side of the vehicular accesses (the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access). Thereafter, no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6 metres in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected, planted or allowed to grow within the areas of such splays.
